description: This Council is asked for its observations on an application (25/01949/FULL) submitted to Westminster City Council for: Variation of condition 1 (approved drawings) and 5 (window details) of planning permission dated 29th February 2024 (RN 23/06144/FULL) for the use of building as 4n self-contained residential units (Use Class C3) with associated demolition and replacement of extensions within central courtyard and at roof level; Creation of third floor external terrace; Alterations/replacement of windows; Replacement of rear boundary wall with dwarf wall and metal railings; Installation of air-source heat pumps; and associated works. NAMELY, amendments to main roof level, mews house roof, Palace Court elevation & lightwell, Ossington Street elevation & lightwell and central lightwell section/elevations.
